expanded_counterpart_rule: The same exact twenty paths and current hashes must be independently decided for each of the three API941 operations, in the new narrative and live counterpart snapshot; a hash-only replacement is insufficient.

tail_ownership_assessment.changed_implementation: Only Machine body changes between the fce313c runtime proposal and this committed snapshot; pool/owner/resetCI and other counterpart bytes remain bound separately.
tail_ownership_assessment.direct_canonical_tail: Move_Roots transfers frame-owned outgoing arguments into a local independent selected-owner arena before Dispatch retires the old frame. No later Args borrow or dereference targets that retired frame.
tail_ownership_assessment.emergency_collection_roots: Dispatch Pin registers callee and arguments in operation roots before destructive retirement. Collector traces those pins and the genuine scalar/cell owners through partial callee setup/refusal; a local Ada vector alone is not treated as a collector root.
tail_ownership_assessment.successful_publication: Push_Frame publishes the actual frame and scalar window before parameter/vararg initialization; it returns the successfully created owner explicitly. Only after Dispatch returns does the bridge clear duplicate Args edges and optionally donate empty reusable capacity to that exact callee.
tail_ownership_assessment.phase_retirement: Driver.Step ends operation roots on success and exception before any later hook/callee/C phase executes. The empty donated arena is physical capacity, not retained logical userdata. Cached frames are cleared and not traced as roots.
tail_ownership_assessment.exceptions_and_continuations: Pending TBC values reject contradictory canonical TAILCALL. Existing protected error, host-abort, native/metamethod/migration tail and yielding continuation protocols remain real execution paths. Selected-owner refusal and cleanup require fresh runtime proof.
tail_ownership_assessment.userdata_implication: Forwarded userdata must remain alive through destination publication and any emergency collection. Discarded arguments and hook-replaced values must not survive through stale request copies. Neither change permits early finalization, delayed weak clearing, repeated callbacks or omitted second-cycle reclamation.
tail_ownership_assessment.witness_limit: The existing Tail_Weak_Argument case uses a table and demonstrates weak identity retirement, not userdata finalizer ordering. Its pass cannot replace the actual API941 thousand-userdata/callback/weak-lifetime counterpart or whole-source evidence.
